evidence: A sharp theological dispute has emerged within Catholicism itself. Critics of Vice President JD Vance — himself a Catholic — argue his rhetoric directly contradicts Church teaching.

Conversely, some Catholic figures, notably Vance himself, have supported the crackdown, and Rep. Jim Jordan defended ICE agents by saying they are 'doing the Lord's work.' This reflects a genuine split within religious communities over how faith obligations interact with national sovereignty and rule of law.
The result is a genuine moral conflict with both sides claiming ethical high ground making immigration one of the most values laden policy debates in contemporary American politics.
